questions.title: Which leader will the Kremlin announce as Vladimir Putin’s counterpart for bilateral talks on the Ukraine war at the 2026 SCO summit?
questions.background: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) holds an annual leaders’ summit, which also provides opportunities for bilateral diplomatic meetings.

Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the leader publicly identified as scheduled to meet Vladimir Putin bilaterally on the sidelines of the 2026 SCO summit to discuss the Ukraine war. (3) Local reporting (Al Jazeera Aug 15, Hindustan Times Aug 17) shows an active Moscow-Ankara Ukraine flashpoint after Russia demanded explanations from the US and Turkey over a potential transfer of US weapons held in Turkey to Kyiv. Combining confirmed attendance, the active Ukraine dispute, and the exact 2025 Tianjin SCO Kremlin-briefing precedent lifts Erdogan 0.35 -> 0.44, while Modi (0.23, active US-India Russian oil tariff/sanctions pressure) and Xi (0.19, confirmed attending) remain strong #2/#3 contenders; trimming Lukashenko (0.05) and Tokayev (0.03), sum = 0.94.

questions.title: Who will be Norway's reigning monarch on August 29, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Norwegian Royal House announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations. Resolution Rule : Identify the person legally holding Norway's crown at the beginning of August 29, 2026, local time. Accession determines the answer, regardless of whether an oath-taking ceremony or coronation has occurred. Accepted Answer Format : The sovereign's regnal name, including the ordinal.
questions.current_reasoning: Favorable 2026-08-25/26 time-decay and stability update: NRK and VG (Aug 25) reported Crown Prince Haakon and Crown Princess Mette-Marit visited King Harald V (89) at Rikshospitalet Tuesday morning while reiterating the palace's Monday afternoon bulletin ('no significant changes, situation remains stable' following Sunday evening's bacterial bloodstream infection deterioration and positive response to IV antibiotics). Through Wednesday Aug 26, no deterioration bulletin, emergency royal summons, death, or abdication has been reported across Norwegian or international press. Having cleared the peak first 72 hours of bacteremia antibiotic therapy with <60 hours remaining until 00:00 CEST Aug 29 (when legal accession determines the outcome; Haakon as Regent does not hold the crown), lifting Harald V 0.82 -> 0.88 while retaining a calibrated 0.12 tail for Haakon VIII given Harald's age, ongoing hospitalization without a discharge bulletin, steroid-treated haemolytic anaemia, and frequent family visits.

Because the question voids if Martinelli stays at Arsenal and no competing club has an active bid (Galatasaray rejected; only prior Atletico Madrid interest), raising Al Hilal 0.78 -> 0.85 (strictly capped at 0.85 pending signed personal terms, medical, and official club announcement) and trimming Atletico Madrid (0.03), Napoli (0.025), AC Milan (0.02), and Juventus (0.015); sum = 0.94 (0.06 residual).
